content.title: The Average Salary Of A Savannah Bananas Player Is Out
content.text: The Savannah Bananas are baseball's newest craze.The league, founded by Jesse Cole, is worth $500 million. The league regularly sells out baseball and football stadiums across the country.“We’ve got to make this the greatest show, the greatest experience possible,” Cole says. “That’s what I’m obsessed with.”AdvertisementCole, though, never thinks about money. Instead, he thinks about the fans.“I never, ever think, ‘How can we bring in more money?’” he says. “The north star is always: ‘How can we create more fans?’ If you create more fans, the money takes care of itself.”Jun 7, 2025; Charlotte, NC, USA; Team owner and master of ceremonies Jesse Cole during the exhibition game between the Savannah Bananas and the Pary Animals at Bank of America Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Jim Dedmon-Imagn Images© Jim Dedmon-Imagn Images (© Jim Dedmon-Imagn Images)The league is made up of former college and professional baseball players. But how much do they get paid?While MLB players are making millions, they're making six figuresThe average salary of a Savannah Bananas player is $100,000. That's significantly more than minor league baseball players make.Advertisement"Banana Ball players make $100K in average salary, the club has revealed 🍌 ," FOS reported."The Savannah Bananas were already on a growth wave, and a first-of-its-kind report from the team details how big. In 2025, the club sold 2.2M tickets to 113 shows (what the club calls games), averaged 500K viewers on TV, and sold 1.9M items of merch."It's impressive how big the league has gotten.This story was originally published by The Spun on Feb 1, 2026, where it first appeared in the Trending section.
